reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is the prohibitively slow inference of standard diffusion models due to their reliance on many denoising steps to achieve accurate multi-modal predictions. LED addresses this by introducing a trainable leapfrog initializer that directly maps from observations to a latent space representing the desired denoised distribution, effectively skipping the early, computationally expensive stages of the diffusion process. This reduces the required number of subsequent denoising steps, yielding substantial speedups while preserving predictive diversity through carefully allocated correlated samples. The method leverages the variational lower bound on the data log-likelihood to train the initializer, ensuring that the accelerated inference remains consistent with the full diffusion model's stationary distribution. Empirical results demonstrate that LED achieves superior accuracy compared to prior arts while attaining real-time inference capabilities.
